title: Classify balanced chain repetitions at every depth
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This answers open question 1 of #6652 for balanced unsigned chains of every depth L≥2. If a block with n of each label repeats d times, let q be the least prime divisor of d absent from n, or infinity if none exists. A q below L obstructs every endpoint. For q above L the shorter target is multiplied by d. For q=L the only surviving shift is (d/L)n^L modulo dn. This gives the exact fixed count in terms of one shorter W row. [Proof](https://github.com/SHIN09-git/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f1a14864f86d15f44671c98735cfd8328f3a1f7b/research/chain-all-depth-powers/PROOF.md)

The proof gives a single divisor D describing all orders that pass the arithmetic conditions. At target zero every divisor is realized, and the minimum rotation period is L times the product of distinct primes ≤L dividing the modulus. A unit-target word can repeat only at prime depth p, exactly p times, subject to a smaller root count. The credited unbalanced depth-six binary square is replayed as a boundary.

At depth five and modulus fifteen, **4,697,520** words have a nontrivial repetition. They all have target 3, least period 15, and form **313,168** shorter cyclic classes. Two different groupings of the 168,168,000 length-15 root words and a separate literal traversal give the same row (4,697,520,0,0). [Numerical certificate](https://github.com/SHIN09-git/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f1a14864f86d15f44671c98735cfd8328f3a1f7b/research/chain-all-depth-powers/ROOT-COUNT.md) · [Literal output](https://github.com/SHIN09-git/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f1a14864f86d15f44671c98735cfd8328f3a1f7b/research/chain-all-depth-powers/literal/RESULT.json)

This is a scoped proof with finite exact computations. The contract concerns algebraic endpoints and rotation classes. Physical scheduling prices, supplier admission and κ require a separate complete budget.

Its source note at `e364eeb19e5268967189ed12aa4813ee73edf3dc` is retained byte-for-byte in publication ancestor `fd1b2f3e103f11734750a0fe93aa2431fd5468ad`. The original provenance accompanies that pin. The final refresh covered 635 open PRs, 5,528 closed/merged PRs, 6,755 Discussion records and the local research-note inventory. Historical diffs and unpublished work fall outside this search. ## Validation

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12 and the standard library,

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chain-all-depth-powers
```

The optional uncompressed census can be repeated with a JDK supporting single-file launch,

```sh
java -Xmx128m research/chain-all-depth-powers/literal/LiteralQuintic.java
```

- Directly checked 309,184 block/power pairs and compared literal periods and cyclic classes with the fixed-count transforms.
- Checked 195,072 binomial coefficients, 979,380 order comparisons, 585 constructed zero-target words and 1,211 powers of 173 published depth-five witnesses.
- The independent prefix/inverse-suffix and middle-gap counters agree at n=2,3. OpenJDK 21.0.10 also traversed every complete word at both sizes, including all 168,168,000 at n=3. The registered Python entry point verifies the stored Java source hash and output.
- Both Python modes return identical full receipts. Seventeen actual private-copy mutations were rejected in each mode for their prescribed reasons. All 22 publication files and declared source ancestry passed the official preflight in an independent full-history checkout. The exact published-head export, SHA-256 `e61c88c4844090520e88301fe3938d27b609ef5edf4177f57d014d97bf9455c6`, passed normal, optimized, fault-injection and literal Java replays with all 23 exported files, including the manifest, byte-identical afterwards. Both hosted jobs passed. GitHub replayed the package and confirmed the committed inputs stayed unchanged. [Hosted checks on the submitted head](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41703336202)

The finite checks support the mathematical proof. The three counting implementations share the same assisted author. Independent human and proof-kernel review remain open. [Reproduction and scope](https://github.com/SHIN09-git/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f1a14864f86d15f44671c98735cfd8328f3a1f7b/research/chain-all-depth-powers/README.md) · [Validation notes](https://github.com/SHIN09-git/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f1a14864f86d15f44671c98735cfd8328f3a1f7b/research/chain-all-depth-powers/VALIDATION.md)

Prepared for SHIN09-git with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The repeated population at m=35,c=12 is W_5(7,1). A published witness already proves positivity. Profiling the full gap counter at n=4 is a concrete first step toward an exact larger count. Separately, the unequal binary profile in #4748 gives a starting test for an extension beyond balanced letter counts.
